name: Divined Scroll
summary: At Silverwind Refuge, the Divined Scroll can expose the mage behind Ashenvale's troubled waters. Night elves use magic from intact water elemental bracers to reveal the summoner's identity.

sections.title: Tracing the Summoner
sections.body: Mystral Lake's tainted waters trouble the Sentinels guarding Ashenvale. Sentinel Velene Starstrike gives travelers an uncharged divining scroll to trace whoever manipulates the water elementals infesting the lake. Gather intact bracers from slain elementals and use them as an arcane reagent; their latent bindings pass into the parchment. The Divined Scroll then reveals the magical signature of the rogue wizard behind the infestation.

sections.title: The Mage Exposed
sections.body: The Divined Scroll's script points Sentinel Velene to a mortal culprit: a reckless mage deliberately corrupting the woodland pools. With this revelation, the Sentinels can plan retribution and send scouts to hunt the summoner responsible for despoiling their sacred wilderness.

faq.q: What is the Divined Scroll used for?
faq.answer: The Divined Scroll reveals the spellcaster summoning and binding hostile water elementals in Ashenvale's lakes, so Sentinel Velene Starstrike can target the culprit.

faq.q: How is the Divined Scroll created?
aliases: how do i get divined scroll
faq.answer: Cast Sentinel Velene Starstrike's blank Divining Scroll upon five Intact Elemental Bracers gathered from defeated water elementals around Mystral Lake.

faq.q: Why are the elemental bracers needed to divine the scroll?
faq.answer: The bracers bind the elementals to the mortal plane. Their residual enchantments give the scroll the magical signature it needs to identify the wizard who conjured them.

faq.q: Who do I bring the Divined Scroll to?
aliases: where do i turn in divined scroll
faq.answer: Bring the finished Divined Scroll to Sentinel Velene Starstrike at Silverwind Refuge, along the road in southern Ashenvale.

angles.text: As a Mage, you can see the principle at work: elemental bindings carry the arcane signature of the wizard who forged them.
As a Night Elf, you know divination tools help the Sentinels find mortal polluters whose arcane meddling threatens Ashenvale's sacred waters.
